concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 4 – Statistical Testing & Multiple‑Comparison Correction (FR‑006 reference)
concerns.text: The plan references FR‑006 (e.g., “Store corrected p‑values alongside raw (FR‑006)”), but FR‑006 does not exist in the specification. This introduces an un‑specified functional requirement, constituting plan over‑reach.
